positions.title: Principal Senior Electrical Engineer
positions.description: FPGA, Custom ASIC, Embedded Software Engineer for machine learning and defense applications.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
●    Embedded software developer for a scalable Elemental Digital Beamforming system that increases signal to noise ratio performance and scalability of radar and communication systems.
●	Designed and implemented Board Support Packages (hardware drivers) in an Element Digital Beamforming platform for increased robustness in an operational, electronic warfare environment. Drivers implemented in C, Qsys, Verilog, and VHDL.
●	Implemented a synchronization algorithm on two distinct software-defined radios that use Xilinx Vivado on the ZedBoard
●	Integrated an operational scenario visualization application to pursue passive radar platform effectiveness, enabling lead engineers and industry counterparts to visualize variance in operational scenarios.
●	Developed a modular test instrument control in Matlab and Python for cross project reuuse.
●	Developed interactive visualization platform to demonstrate analysis on various waveforms and related spectral properties.

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Electronic Engineer
positions.description:
●	Developed a Windriver SIMICs full system simulator in C++, C, Python, and DML
●	Developed and optimized test scripts in ActiveTcl to perform quality assessment 
●	Integrated a sensor controller in C++ to autonomously operate sonar beams and process sonar images.
●	Developed a QT GUI to view noise level and other sonar signal attributes in graph form for engineering analysis.
●	Developed and integrated software in C++ that manages third party data via an image processor to perform autonomous object detection.
●	Created an unattended Microsoft Embedded 7 OS to run on embedded boards with memory constraints.
●	Developed a custom XML parser and validator in C++ to process configurations for the sonar imaging system.
●	Integrated a custom Windows-based application written in C++ for comparable performance on a Linux operating system.
●	Streamlined multi-hour, labor-intensive hardware testing through a custom Java application to simulate user interaction.
●	Developed software in C++ to perform read/writes to multiple FPGA buffers/storage.
●	Modeled a PID controller (proportional-integral-derivative controller) in C++ to control boat rudder and throttle commands via CAN bus.
●	Developed test plans and test implementation in LabView to meet all the system’s required capabilities.
●	Developed ModelSim test-benches to evaluate a nuclear power system controller FPGA capabilities in VHDL.
●	Wrote assertions in PSL and SVA to verify and validate nuclear power system controller FPGA’s requirements.
